data.title: Focus badhane ka 2-minute scientific secret
data.title_en: The 2-minute scientific secret to boost focus

scenes.text: 30-second ka break aapka focus double kar sakta hai.
scenes.text_en: A 30-second break can double your focus instantly.
scenes.text_hi: 30-second का break आपका focus double कर सकता है।

scenes.text: Exam waqt dimaag bhatakna sirf laziness nahi hai.
scenes.text_en: Your mind wandering during exams isn't just laziness.
scenes.text_hi: Exam वक्त दिमाग भटकना सिर्फ laziness नहीं है।

scenes.text: Research suggests iska connection brain ke dopamine signaling se hai.
scenes.text_en: Research suggests this is connected to your brain's dopamine signaling.
scenes.text_hi: Research suggests इसका connection brain के dopamine signaling से है।

scenes.text: Prefrontal cortex mein dopamine dysregulation se focus distract hota hai.
scenes.text_en: Dopamine dysregulation in the prefrontal cortex causes focus to drift.
scenes.text_hi: Prefrontal cortex में dopamine dysregulation से focus distract होता है।

scenes.text: Par research ke mutabiq aapki creativity kaafi high ho sakti hai.
scenes.text_en: But research suggests your creativity could be significantly higher.
scenes.text_hi: पर research के मुताबिक आपकी creativity काफी high हो सकती है।

scenes.text: Ye video us dost ko bhejo jo multitasking mein fansta hai.
scenes.text_en: Send this video to that friend who struggles with multitasking.
scenes.text_hi: ये video उस दोस्त को भेजो जो multitasking में फंसता है।

scenes.text: Focus boost karne ke liye '2-Minute Timer' trick try karo.
scenes.text_en: Try the '2-Minute Timer' trick to boost your focus.
scenes.text_hi: Focus boost करने के लिए '2-Minute Timer' trick try करो।

scenes.text: Pehle timer set karke 2 minute sirf micro-task karo.
scenes.text_en: First, set a timer and do a micro-task for 2 minutes.
scenes.text_hi: पहले timer set करके 2 minute सिर्फ micro-task करो।

scenes.text: Phir 30-second ka 'do-nothing' break lekar rest lo.
scenes.text_en: Then take a 30-second 'do-nothing' break to rest.
scenes.text_hi: फिर 30-second का 'do-nothing' break लेकर rest लो।

scenes.text: Is cycle ko 4-5 baar repeat karke focus badhao.
scenes.text_en: Repeat this cycle 4-5 times to sharpen your focus.
scenes.text_hi: इस cycle को 4-5 बार repeat करके focus बढ़ाओ।

scenes.text: Zyada tension ho toh psychologist se baat karna behtar hai.
scenes.text_en: If the struggle is heavy, talking to a psychologist helps.
scenes.text_hi: ज्यादा tension हो तो psychologist से बात करना बेहतर है।

scenes.text: Bina caffeine ke apna concentration aise double karo.
scenes.text_en: Double your concentration like this without using any caffeine.
scenes.text_hi: बिना caffeine के अपना concentration ऐसे double करो।

data.description: Struggling to focus on studies or work? It might not be laziness. Learn how dopamine affects your brain and try the 2-minute timer trick used by top performers.

fixes: Add a concrete Indian student/professional example (e.g., a Delhi MBA student) to increase specificity
Make the hook slightly more curiosity‑driven, e.g., '30‑second break se focus double?'
Clarify the open loop in scene 3 by hinting at a surprising dopamine fact
Trim any generic filler lines to keep pacing tight
